description: init-consumer.test.ts:100-108 names a sub-block 'engine, MCP shim stub, and CLI JSON expose matching planning fields', but the 'shim' (overviewInitShim) is implemented at lines 153-155 as `return initConsumer(options)` — a direct passthrough that does not exercise the overview.init MCP tool. AC9 says all three surfaces (engine + MCP + CLI) must produce identical JSON, so cross-parity regressions in the MCP wrapper or its zod-strict casting would go undetected by this specific test. init-upsert-tools.test.ts:28-37 does exercise overviewInit() directly, so the regression surface is narrow but real.
suggestedFix: Replace the overviewInitShim stub with a call to overviewInit(context, options) from src/tools/init.ts, building a minimal ServerContext just for the test. Alternatively, add an explicit assertion in init-upsert-tools.test.ts that the MCP overviewInit() result is JSON-equal to the same engine call.
